method: frozen encoder, layer-normalized CLS features and balanced logistic head; no encoder fine-tuning
protocol: identical sampled author/duplicate-disjoint partitions and 5/10/20 windows as MobileBERT pilot
threshold_policy: highest calibration score with >=0.9 sampled calibration recall; no probability calibration
limitations: Small sampled pilot, weak author labels, source bias, limited near-duplicate check, unknown pretraining overlap; no official test or Android test.
